ideas.idea: Prerender or remove ssr:false (use nitro prerender routes)
ideas.why: The fix is specific to this config; the ssr:false problem itself is already known, but prerender routes for / and /guides are a concrete, accurate way to fix it.

ideas.idea: Remove or restrict the noindex middleware to /admin, or remove /guides from sitemap
ideas.why: Accurate to headers.ts and sitemap.xml and directly affects indexing of the main section.

ideas.idea: Replace button router.push with NuxtLink and remove unused useRouter
ideas.why: Accurate and concrete; makes /guides crawlable from the home page.

ideas.idea: Add per-page useSeoMeta titles/descriptions and a titleTemplate
ideas.why: Pages have no per-page metadata and the fix is specific and actionable.

ideas.idea: Add canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card metadata and a favicon
ideas.why: Accurate since none exist, but it is a standard checklist item that applies to nearly any site.

ideas.idea: Add WebSite/Organization JSON-LD in app.vue, plus Article/ItemList/BreadcrumbList on guide pages
ideas.why: Standard advice for any site; there is little real effect for a 3-page site with no entity content.

ideas.idea: Content too thin; add real content, per-trail pages, answer-first quotable format, last-updated date and author
ideas.why: The guides page is a heading and one sentence, so real trail content and per-route pages would help readers and machines understand the site.

ideas.idea: Use absolute Sitemap URL in robots.txt
ideas.why: This is a known problem and is already graded separately, so it adds nothing new.

ideas.idea: Robots.txt Disallow /admin conflicts with noindex on admin; allow crawling and keep noindex
ideas.why: It reverses the deliberate choice that /admin is noindex and disallowed in robots.txt.
Reasonable security advice, but it is not specific to discoverability and applies to any admin area.

ideas.idea: Replace hand-written sitemap with @nuxtjs/sitemap or the @nuxtjs/seo bundle; add lastmod
ideas.why: The sitemap is static with two URLs, so generating it would keep it current as guides are added.

ideas.idea: Add an explicit AI crawler policy in robots.txt for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, etc.
ideas.why: The default already allows all crawlers, so stating a policy has little effect.
The lack of llms.txt is a deliberate choice, and llms.txt is folklore as a way to be found.
